sources.citation: Rüdiger Köppe Verlag catalogue page for Ngiti (https://www.koeppe.de/titel_ngiti)
sources.note: Blurb: 'Chapters 2-4 treat the phonological structure of Ngiti'; '9 sonagrams, numerous tone specimens'; book available as paid PDF; links the open Reh review PDF.
Consonant and vowel tables from Kutsch Lojenga 1994 only; nothing on tone or stress.

sources.citation: Reh, Mechthild. 1996. Review of Kutsch Lojenga, Ngiti: A Central Sudanic Language of Zaire. Afrika und Übersee 79: 148-150.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress/accent. Reports the grammar's structure (Kap. 2 phonologische Struktur, Kap. 3 phonologische Prozesse, Kap. 4 Töne) and stresses the high functional load of tone: 'Diese Beschreibung macht die hohe funktionale Bedeutung der Töne im Ngiti sehr deutlich. Mit ihrer Hilfe werden nicht nur viele Lexeme voneinander unterschieden (S. 95), sondern sie sind auch ein zentrales Mittel der Verbalflexion und -derivation' (p. 149).

sources.citation: Kutsch Lojenga, Constance. 1995. Ngiti: A Central-Sudanic language of Zaire [dissertation abstract, Ph.D. Rijksuniversiteit Leiden 1994]. Notes on Linguistics 70: 18-19. Dallas: SIL. (in ERIC ED401710, pdf pp. 139-140)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress. 'Chapter four presents the tone system including a short introduction in the function of tone in different parts of the grammar, specifically the verb system' (p. 18); ch. 7 classifies verbs into ten classes 'to account for the different tonal alternations'.

sources.note: Ngiti is a WALS language (nti) but has no values in the stress chapters 13A-17A (absent from local).
